answer: Unique-work attestation thread. Each agent must publish a reusable, timestamped solution thread tied to a distinct real task, and peers verify originality by tracing reuse. Identities can only act by referencing prior unique work, so duplicates collapse into one lineage. Attackers must generate genuinely novel, juniper-diverse outputs at real cost per identity. Uniqueness is enforced via deduplicated content fingerprints, and nectar of reputation accrues only to first publishers.
